definitions.explanation: The underground system of pipes and facilities that collects and transports wastewater and rainwater away from buildings and streets.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{下水道|げすいどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This area has a well-developed sewerage system.

examples.japanese: {下水道|げすいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}れない→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: The road is blocked due to sewer construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{下水道|げすいどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あふれた。
examples.english: The sewer overflowed due to heavy rain.

notes:
{下水道|げすいどう} refers to the underground pipe system that collects and transports wastewater and rainwater. It refers specifically to the infrastructure, not the water itself.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧ (sewage, drainage) + {道|どう} (way, channel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下水道|げすいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: sewer construction
- {下水道|げすいどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧: to develop a sewerage system
- {下水道|げすいどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あふれる: the sewer overflows
- {下水道|げすいどう}⟦{処理場|しょりじょう}→処理場：09653_shorijou⟧: sewage treatment plant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下水道|げすいどう}: sewerage system (the infrastructure)
- ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧: sewage, drainage water (the water itself)
- ⟦{上水道|じょうすいどう}→上水道：16651_jousuidou⟧: water supply system (clean water, opposite)

USAGE:
{下水道|げすいどう}⟦{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}→普及率：27131_fukyuuritsu⟧ (sewerage coverage rate) varies significantly between urban and rural areas in Japan.
